summary: Sync stamps the resolved tailnet onto rows from /tailnet/{tailnet}/... lists so typed tables accept them.
reason: {tailnet} is env-backed (TAILSCALE_TAILNET, default '-'), which gives typed tables a NOT NULL tailnet_id scope column, but devices/keys/webhooks objects carry no tailnet field, so every typed insert failed and sync exited non-zero.
validated_outcome: Live sync of devices stored 8 typed rows (was 8/8 typed failures).
